protocol.hypothesis: A breakout after two lower confirmed highs and two higher confirmed lows form a narrowing ZigZag triangle may select stronger moves than generic breakout.
protocol.parameter_rationale: Wing 3/5 bars and reversal 2/4/6% span medium swings; min_narrowing_pct uses two preregistered practical settings. All 12 combinations are evaluated. This is a new use case, not a post-hoc filter of breakout results.
protocol.baseline: One 25% long buy-and-hold position on the same stock and timeframe, filled next open; compare also with separately completed immediate ZigZag breakout run
protocol.signal_rule: After two causally confirmed highs and lows, require the newer high lower, the newer low higher, line width positive and at least min_narrowing_pct narrower than at the second older pivot. Only use points known before signal bar, require newest pivot <=100 bars old. Enter on close crossing projected upper/lower line, reverse on opposite crossing. Fill next open.
protocol.cost_status: after_30bps_round_trip_transaction_cost_equivalent; excludes dividends, short borrow and exchange lots
protocol.selection: Research ranking only; compare the same-stock immediate-breakout experiment and buy-and-hold; no automatic trading approval
limitations: A confirmed pivot is drawn at its historical bar but cannot be traded until wing later bars have closed
Latest ZigZag leg is unstable and is never used as an entry level
Corporate-action coverage is incomplete; results are for research only
Pine chart is for visual review only; Python/Pine parity is unverified
Research parameters and cases are assessed on previously inspected historical data

validation.note: DATA_READY confirms data and report gates only; it does not approve a trading strategy.
